main.description: A requester asks for a task. Written into the coordinator's intake space; only the coordinator can read it. Deleting this record cancels the task.

payload.description: The task type's #request object, e.g. com.hivemind-network.mobility.ride#request. The task type is the NSID of the payload's lexicon (its $type without the #fragment).

selectionMode.description: auto: the coordinator assigns the best offer. choose: the requester picks from the ranked options in the task state.

maxWaitMs.description: Longest the requester will wait for offers. Caps the answer window of the matched feeds.
